entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.Prin.Secy.Home Deptt. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Santosh Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sanjay Srivastava,
learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 202 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376(2) (D) IPC and Section 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Dargah Sharif, District Bahraich.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. This case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 04.07.2022 stating that the applicant had enticed away the informant's daughter aged about 16 years on 09.06.2022.

4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that she is aged 18 years, she used to talk to the applicant for the past one and a half years, she loves him and she had gone to Allahabad by bus alone, where she met with the applicant and went with him to Odisha and she had married the applicant.

entities.text: Kaviraj vs State Of U.P. Thru.Prin.Secy.Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: A similar statement was given by the victim before the Magistrate under Section 164 Cr.P.C..
6. The victim declined to undergo medico legal examination report and in her radiological examination her age has been found to be 18 years.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact,
particularly the fact that in the radiological examination the applicant has been found to be major and she also claimed herself to be major and she has stated that she went out from her home out of her own free will and she has married the applicant, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant Kaviraj be released on bail in Case Crime No. 202 of 2022, under Sections 363,
366, 376(2) (D) IPC and Section 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012,
Police Station Dargah Sharif, District Bahraich on furnishing a bail bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not temper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
10. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Pradeep/-
